Line 11: `String name = mapper.map(getUnrootedName(root, zipEntry.getName()));` This assigns a value to `name`.

Line 12: `if (name != null) {` So if name is not null, we enter the block.

Line 13: `File file = new File(outputDir, name);` Here, `file` is created using `name` as an argument. So the value of `file` directly depends on `name`. Specifically, the `File` object is constructed with `outputDir` and `name`. So the value of `file` after line 13 depends on the value of `name` after line 11.

Then we have an if-else: if `zipEntry.isDirectory()` is true, we do `FileUtils.forceMkdir(file);` (line 15). Otherwise, we go to else block (line 17-26). In the else block, we have line 18: `File tmp2 = file.getParentFile();` (doesn't change file), line 19: `FileUtils.forceMkdir(tmp2);`, then some logging, and finally line 25: `FileUtils.copy(in, file);`. So `file` is used at line 25. The variable `file` is not reassigned between line 13 and line 25. So the value of `file` at line 25 is the same as the value assigned at line 13. Therefore, it depends on `name` at line 11.

Thus, the answer is Yes.
